race.description: Oaks Day @ Port City Bowling Club Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: FANCY SHOULDER (1) disappointed two back before a much better effort when coming back in trip here last time out. Boasts a good track and trip record and Spokes claim is a bonus. Should take up the running from a favourable gate and be tough to run down. VALDER (10) is an exciting filly on the rise, winning by a space first-up before maybe finding them a bit quick when staying at 1000m last time out. Now out to 1200m, that looks a good move for her chances and Rolls replaces the apprentice hoop. Can get back to winning ways. ALL TOO SNEAKY (5) is another who bounced back last start when only 1.6L off the winner a Tamworth last time. Needs a touch of luck from the barrier, but she has good speed and can't be left out of calculations. MOSGIEL DAISY (2) can resume on a positive note after a short break.
